thread:
deploybot: Releasebot flagged release/2026.03.21 for HOLD :warning: Env var REDIS_PREFIX differs between staging and prod overlays. Potential risk: migration will write/read different keyspaces. See diff below.

andrew: @deploybot can you paste the exact diff?

deploybot: Diff snippet from preflight check:
```yaml
staging.values.yaml:
  REDIS_PREFIX: "inference_rw_"
prod.values.yaml:
  REDIS_PREFIX: "inference_rp_"
```

samir: Wait — the migration in the PR writes to the configured REDIS_PREFIX. If the prefix differs, we may end up with duplicate data or consumers reading the wrong keyspace. Who authored the migration?

olivia: that was me. I scoped the migration to staging first to validate behavior. I updated chart v2.3 values to override REDIS_PREFIX in staging, but looks like the overlay for release/2026.03.21 didn't include that change — seems we lost the values.yaml promotion.

kevin: Canary already at 5% in us-west. Do we rollback the image?

andrew: Canary metrics: cache miss rate increased from 0.9% -> 3.4% after the canary cutover. No functional errors yet, but a measurable spike.

samir: If we rollback we avoid risk but lose canary progress. Alternative: hotpatch chart overlay to set REDIS_PREFIX to prod value (so migration uses prod prefix) and promote — but that could make migration touch prod keys unexpectedly.

olivia: I can make the migration idempotent (write with both prefixes + mapping) but that is ~2-3h of work and needs infra review.

andrew: Change window closes in 90m. Proposal: pause rollout, flip feature flag OFF for canary users (FF: infer-new-migration=false) to avoid writes, then block promotion until olivia's patch or a quick safety hotpatch.

deploybot: Action taken: Rollout paused by @andrew at ts=1759123300. release/2026.03.21 state=PAUSED. Canary traffic scaled to 0% for the new deployment.

olivia: ack. I'll open PR "migration: idempotent prefix + mapping" and tag infra and samir. PR ETA ~3h. I'll also create a temporary FF toggle to disable writes immediately.

kevin: Can we add a CI preflight that compares env overrides across overlays (staging vs prod) for critical keys (REDIS_PREFIX, KMS_ALIAS, S3_PREFIX)? Low-effort lint would've caught this.

andrew: Agreed. Samir — can you add a lint rule to the release-checker that fails if REDIS_PREFIX differs between staging/prod overlays? Make it opt-out for legacy services.

samir: On it. I'll aim to push a quick rule and a ticket: INT-4827. If we can't ship the rule in time, we'll at least add a release pipeline warning.

olivia: Plan summary: 1) Rollout paused, 2) I open idempotent migration PR, 3) temporary FF to disable writes to new prefix, 4) infra/samr review, 5) resume after verification (target: tomorrow morning if patch not ready today). I'll update release notes and the release checklist.

andrew: Thanks everyone. Documenting the decision in the release thread and tagging CS in case of user impact. :thumbsup:

kevin: quick log snippet from canary (metrics):
```
2026-03-21T14:25:10Z canary-1 cache_miss_rate=0.034
2026-03-21T14:20:05Z canary-1 cache_miss_rate=0.009
```

samir: created INT-4827: "release-check: env-overlay-key-parity lint" and added a TODO to include REDIS_PREFIX in the critical-keys list.

olivia: I'll post PR link here when ready and ping infra. Thanks team.
